# Where Krónos works now: the myths behind the markets
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Krónos** never stopped working.

Krónos is the hinge between the primordial gods and the Olympian order. His myth is the myth of generational succession — the son who overthrows the father and is in turn overthrown.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Krónos
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Time, Harvest, Titans
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Culture & Entertainment · Energy & Natural World · Commerce & Governance
- **Strongest seat:** Timekeeping & Calendar Systems
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 132 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Castration of Ouranos.** Ouranos hated the children Gaia bore him and hid them inside her.  Gaia fashioned a great stone sickle and persuaded her sons to avenge her. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**The Swallowed Children.** Warned that one of his children would overthrow him, Krónos devoured each infant Rhea bore him: Hestía, Deméter, Hera, Hádes, and Poseidôn.  Rhea, grieving, hid Zeus in a Cretan cave and gave Krónos a stone wrapped in swaddling clothes. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Timekeeping & Calendar Systems

*Watches, calendars, and time sciences. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*Time personified; chronograph, chronology, chronic — his name keeps the hours.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Krónos performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Agriculture, Food & Harvest

*Farming, grain, food production, and agtech. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The sickle-bearing Titan of the harvest.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Ancestry & Heritage Services

*Genealogy, heritage research, and DNA ancestry. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*Father of six Olympians; the ruling dynasty's patriarch and cautionary progenitor.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Leadership, Governance & Public Administration

*Government, executive leadership, and statecraft. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The succession myth itself — the king who devours his heirs and is overthrown in turn; governance's oldest case study.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Krónos performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Krónos is the hinge between the primordial gods and the Olympian order. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in timekeeping & calendar systems, agriculture, food & harvest, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/kronos/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
